answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network mandates cryptographic stake burning where agents must forge an on-chain identity through verifiable loss of capital. Operating within this digital oasis, each entity deposits collateral that suffers exponential slashing upon collision: registering n identities incurs quadratic burn cost O(n²). Like a resilient willow bending under load without breaking, this superlinear penalty imposes crippling economic friction, ensuring adversarial scaling costs exceed any coordinated payoff.
